# SegmentStream Build Your Own

> Blueprints for building your company's own software with a coding agent: marketing analytics, CRM, email marketing, bookkeeping, ad fraud detection, a company agent, a document drive and e-signature. Each blueprint is a design, an interview, invariants with tests, variations and pitfalls. An agent builds the company's own version on SegmentStream; nothing is installed or forked.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/AGENTS.md): the build procedure a coding agent follows
- [registry.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/registry.json): every blueprint with its metadata
- [Foundation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/foundation/FOUNDATION.md): shared companies, contacts, members and conventions
- [SDKs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/SDKS.md): the public SDKs and where they are documented

## Blueprints

- [Marketing analytics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/blueprints/marketing-analytics/BLUEPRINT.md): Your own tracker, sessions, identity graph, ad costs, conversions and attribution in a warehouse you own, with reports on people, channels, spend and the AI agents that read your site. Replaces Google Analytics (GA4), Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel, Heap, Matomo, Plausible, PostHog, Triple Whale, Northbeam, Rockerbox, Hyros, Dreamdata, HockeyStack, Google Ads and Meta Ads attribution reports.
- [CRM](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/blueprints/crm/BLUEPRINT.md): Leads from your forms, triage, deal pipelines and customers on your own companies and contacts, shaped to how you sell. Replaces Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Zoho CRM, Monday Sales CRM, Freshsales, Attio, Close CRM.
- [Email marketing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/blueprints/email-marketing/BLUEPRINT.md): Consent by topic, audiences on your own customer records, campaigns with a separate approval, and delivery events that keep your list clean. Replaces Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot Marketing Hub, ActiveCampaign, Brevo, Kit (formerly ConvertKit), MailerLite, Campaign Monitor, Omnisend.
- [Bookkeeping](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/blueprints/bookkeeping/BLUEPRINT.md): One general ledger for invoices, bills, expenses with receipts, fixed assets and multi-currency, with the reports your accountant reads. Replaces QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, FreshBooks, Zoho Books, Wave Accounting.
- [Ad fraud and bot detection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/blueprints/ad-fraud-detection/BLUEPRINT.md): A verdict with its evidence for every website session and conversion: SegmentStream's complete production rules for bots, spoofed crawlers, automation, data-centre traffic and AI agents. Replaces ClickCease, CHEQ, TrafficGuard, Spider AF, Fraud Blocker, ClickGUARD, HUMAN Security, DoubleVerify, Integral Ad Science, Anura, Polygraph.
- [Company agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/blueprints/company-agent/BLUEPRINT.md): An AI agent in your team's chats that works on your own records, with the permissions of whoever asks. Replaces Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Gemini for Google Workspace, Slack AI, Glean, Lindy, Dust, Zapier Agents.
- [Drive](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/blueprints/drive/BLUEPRINT.md): Company files and online documents in one folder tree, with versions, PDFs, sharing, comments and an access log. Replaces Google Drive, Google Docs, Microsoft SharePoint, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, Notion.
- [E-signature](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/segmentstream/build-your-own/main/blueprints/e-signature/BLUEPRINT.md): Envelopes, signers, a signing page and sealed, timestamped PDFs. Replaces DocuSign, Adobe Acrobat Sign, Dropbox Sign (formerly HelloSign), PandaDoc, SignNow, Zoho Sign, BoldSign, Yousign, SignWell, OneSpan Sign.
